hero.h1: The sprint runs on software we built ourselves.
body: It learns from every one of your recorded sales calls while the sprint runs. The prospect list, the conversations, the proposals and the content all learn from the same calls.
After day 45, you keep all of it.
aside: Nothing on this page is sold separately.
We personalize all of them for your business and deliver it so you can keep using it after the 6 weeks are over.

intro: The recordings guide precisely who to target, what to post, how to start conversations and how to close them.
We use 1 tool for the 4 stages.

stages.name: Lead Finder
stages.line: A Chrome plugin. It scores the leads most likely to respond to your message, based on who bought from you and worked with you before, defined by us and your recordings.

stages.name: DM 2 Call App
stages.line: LinkedIn's inbox sucks. We fixed it. This one shows you your most valuable conversations, the ones that will drive booked calls, shared with a trained appointment setter.

stages.name: Sally your Sales Ally
stages.line: An AI agent that reviews every recorded call against a ten-stage rubric and writes the proposal from the transcript.

stages.name: Every call improves the system
stages.line: Each reviewed call tightens who gets targeted, what gets said in the DMs and how the offer lands on the next call.

loop.payoff: Learn feeds Find, and the loop closes.

leadFinder.lead: One click on a profile. A written verdict by morning.
body: A Chrome extension. The specialist opens a prospect on LinkedIn and saves the profile with one click. Overnight, the system scores the person against your ideal client file and writes its verdict: KEEP or SKIP, with the reasons spelled out.
The prospect list stops being a guess before the first message goes out.

dmApp.lead: The screen your specialist works from, every day.
body: It ranks which conversations deserve attention first and tracks every thread from first touch to booked meeting. Follow-ups fire on time without anyone remembering them.
Your Notion CRM stays in sync on its own, and a report lands every week showing exactly where each conversation stands.

sally.lead: A teammate built around your calls. Named for where she was born: sales.
body: Sally lives inside your own Claude. She reviews every recorded sales call against a ten-stage rubric, quoting the exact lines with timestamps. She writes the proposal straight from the transcript into your Drive, and drafts LinkedIn content in your voice.
She reads the verdicts from Lead Finder, knows how you talk, and knows when a proposal went out. The engine behind the sprint.

diagnostic.h2: Score one of your calls before you talk to us.
diagnostic.body: Paste one sales call transcript. About four minutes later you get a scored diagnostic PDF and a LinkedIn post drafted from that same call. Free. The transcript is read once and never stored.
diagnostic.note: The same rubric Sally uses inside the sprint.

trust.h2: Everything runs where you can see it.
trust.lead: Nothing happens in a black box.

rows.b: Conversations run with your credentials, never a burner profile. You see what goes out, and replies come to you.
All prospect data, verdicts and reviews live in storage you own. Cancel everything tomorrow and it stays yours.
The free diagnostic reads a transcript once, scores it, and never stores it.

a: Everything stays with you. The tools keep running on your accounts, your data stays in your Drive, and the booked calls are yours.
What stops is the daily conversation work. If you want it to keep moving, there is a retainer. If you would rather run it yourself, you get the documented system and a full handover.

rows.q: Who operates this day to day?
a: A trained specialist we place. They work from the DM 2 Call App on your LinkedIn account, under our review.
You see everything that goes out. Replies come to you.

rows.q: Do I need my own Claude?
a: Yes, for Sally. She lives inside your own Claude account, which is how everything she learns stays yours.
A standard Claude subscription is enough. We set her up during the sprint.

rows.q: Can my existing VA run it?
a: Yes. The daily work was built to be teachable. Your VA can shadow the specialist during the sprint.
The handover covers the rest: the playbooks, the DM 2 Call App, and how Sally files her work.

close.h2: The tools are real. So is the pipeline they build.
close.body: Fifteen minutes tells us both whether the sprint fits your business. Or hand us one call first and see the rubric work on your own transcript.
